bifrost: springboard/bifrostd/src/lib.rs, springboard/proto/src/lib.rs, springboard/sdk/src/control.rs, springboard/sdk/src/notification.rs, springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs, springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs, springboard/sdk/src/service_management.rs, springboard/src/bin/portal.rs, docs/privd-protocol.md
summary: BifrOSt has no XPC API for apps: no XPCSession, XPCListener, XPC activities or XPC event handlers. It covers part of the same job with a service supervisor (bifrostd, restarts services with backoff), a root daemon contract (privd), an owner-only JSON-RPC control socket per app, in-process and distributed notifications, and ProcessInfo activities that keep an app running in the background.

features.note: Wave 3 (theme-21, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No SDK type for typed peer-to-peer sessions with a listener. The control socket is one request per connection and is served by the app for agents and tools, not for app-to-app messaging. The shell-to-app protocol is internal and not exposed to apps.

features.feature: XPC services launched on demand, shut down when idle, restarted on crash
features.bifrost: springboard/bifrostd/src/lib.rs (kind = "service" packages run as child processes, restarted with backoff, new version swapped in after a ping); springboard/sdk/src/service_management.rs (SMAppService, mainApp only)
features.note: The supervisor restarts services and swaps versions after a health check, but there is no on-demand launch and no idle shutdown. Apps get no SDK API to declare or connect to a service; SMAppService.register is the only app-facing call and it covers the main app only.

features.apple: XPC services with privileged LaunchDaemon (via Service Management)
features.bifrost: docs/privd-protocol.md (contract for the root daemon bifrost-privd, proto 1); springboard/src/bin/portal.rs (D-Bus org.freedesktop.portal.Settings service)
features.note: Root work is planned to go through bifrost-privd, but the protocol is a system contract with no app-facing SDK API. The portal is a D-Bus service for Linux toolkit apps, not an XPC counterpart.

features.apple: XPC activities (xpc_activity_register, criteria, defer and check-in)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs (ActivityOptions: USER_INITIATED, LATENCY_CRITICAL, BACKGROUND, IDLE_SYSTEM_SLEEP_DISABLED); springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs:213 (beginActivity keeps an app running after it leaves the foreground)
features.note: Activities keep an app from being suspended and hint the system's throttling. There is no scheduler: no criteria, interval, deferral or system-run callback like XPC activities.

features.feature: XPC events (on-demand IOKit and notification events)
features.apple: XPC events (IOKit matching, system notifications delivered to a service)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/notification.rs (NotificationCenter, DistributedNotificationCenter add_observer, post); springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs (NSWorkspace-style calls)
features.note: Named notifications work inside the app process, with a distributed variant that posts through the shell. Nothing wakes a service from a device or IOKit event. Cross-process delivery of the distributed variant was not verified in code.

features.apple: XPC objects (xpc_dictionary_t, xpc_array_t, xpc_string_t and others)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/coding.rs (Codable and plist); bifrost_core::json (JSON values used by control and intent calls)
features.note: Messages are JSON or plist, not XPC objects. Apps that already use Codable or JSON can exchange data, but there is no typed XPC object model or XPC-compatible wire format.

features.feature: XPC connections and endpoints (XPCEndpoint, anonymous listeners)
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-21, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No endpoint objects that can be passed between processes, and no peer requirement or code-signing check. Access control is owner-UID only.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/control.rs (SO_PEERCRED owner check); springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (bubblewrap sandbox policy for apps)
features.note: The owner UID check covers same-user access. There is no requirement on bundle identity, signing or entitlements, because BifrOSt has no code-signing peer check.

gaps: No SDK API for XPC-style typed sessions between an app and a helper (XPCListener, XPCSession, XPCReceivedMessage).
No app-facing way to declare a helper service that the system launches on demand and shuts down when idle. bifrostd only restarts services.
No XPC activity scheduler (criteria, intervals, deferral, system-run callback) in the SDK.
No endpoint objects for passing a connection to another process, and no peer requirement beyond the owner UID.
No event wake-up for services from device or IOKit events.
